scope: Known species, state-layout, model-selection, output-field, and persistence hardcoding in pyDAC v3 before the extensibility refactor.
audit_patterns: species literals: CO2, H2O, O2, N2, Ar, SPECIES
packed result keys: y_2d, y_1d, y_scalars
state arithmetic: fixed multiples of N, fixed Nc_* values, fixed field indices

entries.hardcoding: The immutable catalog owns molecular weights, Lennard-Jones data, Fuller volumes, conductivity values, and Shomate coefficients. Declared-order arrays serve initialization and the generic RHS; localized DAC aliases remain only for reporting compatibility, alongside the standalone steam-flow utility.
entries.disposition: retain catalog-owned arrays in the physical setup; the standalone steam utility is DAC-specific and reads the catalog for H2O molecular weight, while supervised reporting aliases remain intentional

entries.hardcoding: The composition root and runtime bundle expose only named schema-v2 mixture/model declarations. Fixed CO2/H2O schema-v1 knowledge remains isolated in the load-time migration.
entries.disposition: retain the explicit schema-v1 load-time migration until compatibility removal is scheduled

sites: short name-based contracts and explicit physical registries in src
parameterized CompetitiveSips equation with validation-owned fit coefficients
entries.hardcoding: Toth, GAB, WADST coupling, parameterized competitive Sips, and LDF implement directly readable name-keyed contracts in src; the RHS calls equilibrium once and then physical kinetic rates by adsorbate. Sorbent-specific competitive-Sips coefficients are supplied by the input document.
entries.disposition: extend only through the explicit registries, name-keyed contracts, and external parameter datasets

sites: column.validation warm-start shape and sorbent-inventory checks
entries.hardcoding: StateLayout owns setup, closure reconstruction, field shapes, warm starts, inventories, solver packing, RHS decomposition/assembly, buffers, and per-adsorbate KPI scalar generation. The current-DAC layout remains only an explicit compatibility/test preset.
entries.disposition: retain StateLayout as the sole numerical packing owner

entries.hardcoding: Reference/feed/initial compositions, closure reconstruction, property arrays, gas and loading balances, adsorption heat, and energy accumulation all follow declared names and layout-generated fields. Current-DAC RH, dry-air, and reporting conveniences remain explicit outside numerical field ownership.
entries.disposition: governing equations use declared species; retain or guard the documented DAC input/reporting conveniences

entries.hardcoding: Constraint slices, per-state tolerances, dimensionalization, final fields, and persisted field order are generated from StateLayout metadata; saved solutions include the layout document and signature.
entries.disposition: StateLayout generates solver/export metadata; post-processing consumes the persisted layout

sites: layout-derived analytical block map and sizes
pressure and hot-bed named field extraction
entries.hardcoding: Sparsity generation, pruning, events, pressure plateau, and hot-bed diagnostics consume StateLayout fields. New sparsity caches include the layout signature; legacy unsigned caches are accepted only for the exact current-DAC layout signature.
entries.disposition: retain the narrow signed compatibility rule for checked-in current-DAC masks

entries.hardcoding: Mixture and model selection are generic name-based declarations, and initialization consumes species-named reference/step fields when present. Current DAC heats, reference defaults, termination fields, and dry-air/RH compatibility inputs remain explicit.
entries.disposition: retain readable current-DAC defaults and their explicit RH/dry-air/termination conveniences; supply validation-specific material data separately, with DAC-only consumers guarded at their reporting boundaries

entries.hardcoding: The context schema expands per-species dispersion rows from the declared mixture and validates the same ordered species set across saved step blocks.
entries.disposition: runtime context and normalization are declaration-driven

sites: fixed plot field registries and mixture MW
entries.hardcoding: New saved solutions are decoded exclusively through persisted StateLayout names; the only positional compatibility branch recognizes the exact historical current-DAC storage counts.
entries.disposition: retain the narrow layout-less DAC fallback and explicit required-species guards

sites: CO2 recovery/productivity and O2/N2 impurity KPIs
entries.hardcoding: Mass records, mass tables, and basic plots follow declared species; product purity, H2O/CO2, CO2-specific energy/productivity, and impurity reporting intentionally encode DAC definitions.
entries.disposition: generic metrics remain declaration-driven, while DAC KPIs stay behind explicit required-species guards and are not part of the generic core
entries.owner: generic metrics plus guarded DAC KPI layer

sites: api/cli CSS report runs the DAC O2 hot-bed audit
entries.hardcoding: Optimization reporting is deliberately DAC-specific but currently lacks an explicit compatibility boundary.
entries.disposition: retain optimization/reporting as explicitly DAC-specific consumers of DAC objective columns and campaign artifacts; they do not define generic species layout or model selection

sites: Component construction and fixed CO2/H2O/O2 result keys
entries.hardcoding: Flash utilities are explicitly binary/ternary DAC calculations and are not generic mixture infrastructure.
entries.disposition: retain standalone guarded DAC flash utilities; their binary/ternary critical-property and result-key definitions are not generic mixture infrastructure and have no current generic consumer

sites: validate_steps_against_mixture (steam steps need H2O, collected steps need CO2)
EVENT_METRIC_REQUIREMENTS (the O2 metric needs O2, the CO2-loading metric needs CO2 adsorbed; checked for event-mode steps)
candidate KPI adapter: T_steam_condensation NaN without H2O
entries.hardcoding: Steam steps inject H2O and a collected step reports CO2 product, so the run preflight names these two species; the NSGA-II KPI adapter names the steam-condensation limit, which a mixture without H2O does not have.
entries.disposition: retain: physical requirements of named steps, checked before a run writes anything
entries.owner: run preflight and NSGA-II candidate KPIs

coverage_rule: Every Python file matching an audit pattern must appear in at least one inventory entry; new matches fail the inventory test until classified.
